steps.designation: Civil Judge (Junior Division) / Judicial Magistrate First Class (JMFC)
steps.promotion_criteria: Direct recruitment conducted by High Court of Madhya Pradesh (Preliminary Exam, Main Written Exam and Viva-Voce), followed by 1-year institutional training at Madhya Pradesh State Judicial Academy (MPSJA), Jabalpur.
steps.source_label: Madhya Pradesh Judicial Service (Recruitment and Conditions of Service) Rules

steps.designation: Civil Judge (Senior Division) / Chief Judicial Magistrate (CJM) / ACJM
steps.promotion_criteria: Promotion on seniority-cum-merit by High Court of MP after 5 years of satisfactory judicial service as Civil Judge (Junior Division), based on disposal quotas and ACR scrutiny.

steps.designation: Additional District & Sessions Judge (ADJ / Additional District Judge)
steps.promotion_criteria: Promotion to Higher Judicial Service cadre either through Limited Departmental Competitive Examination (LDCE 10% quota) after 5 years as Senior Civil Judge or through regular DPC quota (65% quota) based on merit-cum-seniority.
steps.source_label: Madhya Pradesh Higher Judicial Service Rules 2017

steps.designation: Principal District & Sessions Judge (PDJ / District Judge)
steps.promotion_criteria: Selection and posting as Head of District Judiciary by Full Court of High Court of Madhya Pradesh on seniority-cum-suitability.
steps.source_label: MP Higher Judicial Service Selection Guidelines

steps.designation: Judge, High Court of Madhya Pradesh
steps.promotion_criteria: Elevation to High Court Bench under Article 217(2)(a) of the Constitution of India via Supreme Court Collegium recommendation from state judicial service quota.

papers.paper_name: Law Subjects (110 marks: CPC, CrPC, IPC, Evidence, Contract, TPA, Specific Relief, Limitation, MP Accomodation, MP Land Revenue, NI Act, Constitution) + GK (20) + Computer (10) + English (10)

stages.source_label: High Court of MP Civil Judge Examination Scheme, Section 8

papers.paper_name: Paper II: Writing Skill, Court Practice & Current Legal Knowledge
Paper IV: Judgment Writing (Framing of Issues, Charges & Civil/Criminal Judgment)

stages.source_label: High Court of MP Civil Judge Mains Syllabus

papers.paper_name: Interview / Personality & Legal Knowledge Evaluation (Minimum 40% qualifying marks)

stages.source_label: High Court of MP Viva-Voce Regulations

financial_package.pay_source_label: Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) Scale, MPHC Notification

official_perks.perk_description: Dearness Allowance at 58% of basic pay (₹45,147 per month at entry level) under SNJPC judicial pay scales.
Official earmarked judicial residence with camp office facility or judicial HRA as per Supreme Court directions.
official_perks.source_label: Supreme Court of India (All India Judges Association Case) Directives

official_perks.perk_description: Monthly sumptuary allowance and office orderly allowance for maintaining judicial decorum and residential office work.
Fuel reimbursement and conveyance allowance for judicial officers.
Periodic robe allowance, monthly domestic helper/orderly allowance, electricity/water bill reimbursements.
